edges.description: The full-system Drive document is a broad human-readable architecture map; it routes across projects but does not replace their owning current-state sources.
The Working Master preserves deep cross-project architecture and research reasoning while live owner sources retain volatile implementation authority.
The ecosystem map gives a compact orientation layer before a reader follows the tree into exact project or evidence sources.
The System OS bridge records current-versus-research distinctions and helps prevent research architecture from being mistaken for activated runtime.
The research program provides a cross-project map of cognitive questions; each question still routes to its owning domain for authority.
The multi-AI trace preserves detailed discussion and hypothesis evolution for understanding, experience, and the current cognitive frontier.
The research program uses the council document to interpret model roles, evidence, and routing without treating model agreement as truth authority.
The full-system architecture explains the ecosystem in depth, while Crosswalk is the focused cross-project relationship and boundary map.
The full-system architecture supplies detailed explanation; Atlas supplies higher-level navigation and orientation to the relevant owning surfaces.
The Working Master contains cross-project cognitive research reasoning that may route into CLOS, but CLOS remains the owning substrate-neutral research surface.
